answer:
Use the OpenFOAM solver buoyantBoussinesqPimpleFoam on a 2D square cavity of size 1 m x 1 m.
Generate a uniform mesh of 41 x 41 cells using blockMesh.
The fluid is air under the Boussinesq approximation with a reference temperature of 295 K, thermal expansion coefficient beta = 1/295 K^-1, and effective kinematic viscosity nu = 4.859e-3 m^2/s and thermal diffusivity alpha = 6.844e-3 m^2/s (chosen so that Ra = 1e4 and Pr = 0.71 for L = 1 m and deltaT = 10 K).
Gravity vector is (0 -9.81 0) m/s^2.
Set the left wall temperature boundary condition to fixedValue 300 K.
Set the right wall temperature boundary condition to fixedValue 290 K.
Set the top and bottom wall temperature boundary conditions to zeroGradient (adiabatic).
Set the velocity boundary condition on all four walls to noSlip.
Use the PIMPLE time scheme with a fixed time step of dt = 0.01 s.
Use the default PIMPLE corrector settings (1 outer corrector, 2-3 inner correctors).
Run the simulation until steady state is reached, defined as the residuals for U, p, and T all dropping below 1e-4 and the maximum change in the velocity and temperature fields over successive time steps becoming negligible.
Set endTime to 100 s as a safety cap on the simulation duration.
